answer: Because the horizon pair is tracked in the shale ledger, the nectar audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 24%. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 103 identities means 103 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
